title: Bay of Bengal Regional Plan of Action to Prevent, Deter and Eliminate Illegal, Unreported and Unregulated Fishing
decision_details: The International Plan of Action to Prevent, Deter and Eliminate Illegal, Unreported and Unregulated Fishing was unanimously adopted by the member States of the Food and Agriculture Organization in 2001 with the aim of restoring depleted fish stocks and ensuring food security. Consequently, Sri Lanka has also prepared a National Action Plan for the same. Similarly, the member States of the Bay of Bengal Programme Inter-Governmental Organization, have collectively agreed to sign a Regional Plan of Action to address illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing in the region. The Plan aims to strengthen the prevention, deterrence and elimination of illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing in the exclusive economic zones of Bangladesh, India, Maldives and Sri Lanka, as well as in the surrounding seas and oceans beyond national jurisdiction. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to sign the said Regional Plan of Action, was approved by the Cabinet.
